questions.Q01: *(CEO)* How many MCF-7 samples were exposed to 4-OHT, across all five studies? Count resistant MCF-7 lines grown in 4-OHT. Don't count samples whose tamoxifen form isn't stated.
questions.Q02: *(Head of data)* How many control samples does each study have? A control is a sample given no drug, hormone or growth factor (only the solvent, or nothing at all), including 0-hour baselines and parental lines, whatever was done to its genes.
questions.Q03: *(Head of data)* Which cell lines are in the data, and how many samples does each have? Count tamoxifen-resistant derivatives under the line they were made from.
questions.Q04: *(Scientist)* Which compounds were added to cells, and in how many samples each? Count the solvents too. Keep tamoxifen of an unstated form separate from 4-OHT.
questions.Q05: *(CEO)* How many distinct tamoxifen-resistant cell lines do we have, and which lab made each?
questions.Q06: *(Head of data)* How many genes can we compare across all five studies?
questions.Q07: *(Scientist)* Which samples are the right controls for the RAR-alpha knockdown samples in GSE26298?
questions.Q08: *(Scientist)* How many samples in GSE21618 never had anything added to them before their RNA was taken?
questions.Q09: *(Scientist)* What concentration of 4-OHT did each study use?
questions.Q10: *(Scientist)* How long were cells exposed to 4-OHT before RNA was collected, in each study that used 4-OHT?
questions.Q11: *(Head of data)* Which treated samples have no control (solvent-only or untreated) with the same cells in the same experimental run?
questions.Q12: *(Scientist)* Which studies removed estrogen from the growth medium before treating the cells, and which didn't?
questions.Q13: *(Head of data)* Which samples have labels that contradict each other?
questions.Q14: *(Head of data)* Is any dose written at an impossible level anywhere in the data? If so, where, and what should it be?
questions.Q15: *(Head of data)* In which studies are the deposited expression values not what GEO's own processing description says they are?
questions.Q16: *(Head of data)* How many gene names have been corrupted into dates by Excel, and in which study?
questions.Q17: *(Scientist)* Which samples carry a replicate label that is repeated or wrong?
questions.Q18: *(Scientist)* Is GREB1 induced by 24 hours of 4-OHT in ordinary MCF-7, compared with its own control, in every study that tested this?
questions.Q19: *(Scientist)* In GSE117942, which compound raised GREB1 in every cell line, compared with DMSO from the same run?
questions.Q20: *(Scientist)* Does 24 hours of estradiol (E2) raise GREB1 in ordinary MCF-7 in every study that tested it, compared within each experimental run?
questions.Q21: *(Scientist)* In GSE26298, how much lower is ESR1 in the ESR1-knockdown samples than in their own experiment's control?
questions.Q22: *(Scientist)* In GSE111151, which tamoxifen-resistant line shows the largest drop in ESR1 compared with its parental line?
questions.Q23: *(CEO)* Which studies can't simply be pooled with the others to study 4-OHT response, and why?
questions.Q24: *(Head of data)* Which studies measured ordinary MCF-7 given 4-OHT for a stated 24 hours with a matched control in the same run, so that their responses can be combined?
questions.Q25: *(CEO)* Combining only the studies that can be combined, what is the average change in GREB1 after 24 hours of 4-OHT in ordinary MCF-7?
